uzo.purpose: Frames an application: its name and who is signed in, the main navigation, the notices of the application and the page in the main — the same on every page, so a person and a screen reader find their way the same way everywhere.

instead.kialo: The content of one page is a pagxo in the main of the shell, because the shell stays while the pages change.

boundary.kialo: A shell inside a shell is not supported, because two banners and two mains leave a screen reader with two pages in one (landmarks once per page).
A column beside the main that holds more than the navigation is a layout of round 2, because the columns share the width by a rule of their own; a person decides until it comes.

with.kialo: The main navigation stands in the region nav, because the navigado is the landmark navigation and the shell sets it once.
A notice of the application stands in the region notices, because that region is a polite live region: it is heard where the focus is.
The skip link is the shell's own, the first focusable element of the page, because it leads past the repeated parts to the main.
The page stands in the main, because the shell stays while the pages change.
